about: Golden values for the synthetic chromatin BAM written by tests/nuc_fixtures.chromatin_bam with the generator settings below. Counts were derived independently of FiberBrowser and FiberHMM: by parsing the BAM's MA nuc.QQQ calls with pysam and counting calls whose midpoint lies in the view (tests/test_nuc_golden.py::_truth). The NRL bands are the generator's planted repeats (190 bp and 172 bp arrays, sd 3 bp) widened by the 4 bp histogram bin and per-molecule averaging; the irregular view's spacing is uniform 150-300 bp, so its median must sit above both arrays.
